{{Quote|Defense towers fire at will!|Iziz trooper|<ref name="Tales of the Jedi 2">[[Tales of the Jedi 2|''Tales of the Jedi'' 2]]</ref>}}
The '''Iziz defense towers''' were a series of [[Battle station/Legends|battle stations]] that were designed to protect the walled [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] and only settlement on the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]]. The towers were armed with ranged energy weapons, such as [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] and [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]], that were capable of repelling both land-based and aerial assaults.

The network of defense towers saw action in [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], during the [[Battle of Iziz]], where they were employed against the [[Beast Riders]] from Onderon's wilderness. These emplacements were subsequently destroyed, when Iziz was virtually leveled after the battle. However, they would be replaced some [[3951 BBY|fifty years later]] by a network of [[air defense tower]]s. The new defensive network would see action during the [[Onderon Civil War]], when the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]] returned to that world to help [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Talia (Onderon)|Talia]] fend off the [[Sith Triumvirate|Sith]]-backed coup d'état staged by her cousin, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Vaklu]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Very well, Novar. Order the defense towers to fire ion cannons and turbolasers at will!|Queen Amanoa|audio=AmanoaFireAtWill-TOTJ.flac|<ref name="TOTJA" />}}
Defense towers were planetary emplacements, built and stationed along the walls of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]], the capital city of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]].<ref name="BWOO" /> They carried armaments of both long-range defensive [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] batteries and [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannons]].<ref name="TOTJA" /> These weapons were manned on swiveling platforms by [[Wave gunner]]s, a faction of
Iziz's [[Naddist army|army]]. The towers were specifically designed to combat the [[Drexl|flying beasts]] ridden by the [[Beast Riders]] of Onderon's wilderness. While offering ample protection from land-based attacks, defense towers were less protected from aerial assaults, as their tops were open to allow for greater firing mobility. However, the towers were easily destroyed when subjected to precision strikes from the Beast Riders' heavy [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]].<ref name="BWOO" />

Turbolasers and ion cannons were mounted on the uppermost section of the tower, allowing for full range when targeting [[drexl]]s or invading aircraft alike. Laser fire from the batteries manifested as a concentrated blast of yellow [[Laser/Legends|energy]], capable of vanquishing a Drexl-mounted Beast Rider with a direct hit.<ref name="BWOO" /> Also, the recharge time between turbolaser blasts was relatively short. This allowed the Wave gunners to fire at targets constantly, and stir enough apprehension within approaching enemies to cause them to rethink their attack strategy.<ref name="TOTJA" /> A new network of defensive structures was put in place some time prior to [[3951 BBY]]. These towers were enclosed structures, manned by at least four [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]], led by an officer, and equipped with one pair of [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] apiece.<ref name="kotor2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref>

==History==
===Beast Wars===
[[File:BattleofIziz.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Defense towers in action during the Beast Wars.]]
{{Quote|The barbarians are swarming&mdash;order the ''Wave gunners'' to hit them hard!|Iziz trooper, during the Battle of Iziz|<ref name="Tales of the Jedi 2" />}}
In the year [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], Iziz requested aid from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], who in turn sent a number of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] on their behalf to quell the prolonged [[Beast Wars|civil war]] which had plagued the planet. When the Jedi arrived, they were attacked by [[Oron Kira]]'s Beast Riders, who knew of their arrival before the citizens of Iziz did. The Jedi immediately called for assistance from the city, and the defense towers were ready; they opened fire with their defensive batteries, downing several of the pursuing Riders.<ref name="BWOO" />

During the [[Battle of Iziz]] of the same year, the defense towers again saw action against those same Beast Riders, who were led this time by Oron Kira's father, the [[Beast-Lord]] [[Modon Kira]].<ref name="BWOO" /> Four defense towers were situated along the northern wall of Iziz, and these were the first to meet the oncoming Beast Riders in battle. Upon sight of their approach, [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Amanoa]] of Iziz instructed her servant [[Novar (Human)|Novar]] to order the Wave gunners to fire their turbolasers and ion cannons, in an attempt to repel the attack. The gunners did as commanded, but had quickly become overwhelmed by the onslaught of Beast Riders, who had amassed the largest army the city-dwellers had ever seen. As the Beast Rider ground troops made their way over the city ramparts, several of them were able to scale the defense towers. ''Gunner 1'', the Wave gunner from the first of the defense towers, noticed the Beast Riders preparing to attack the fourth tower, and [[Comlink/Legends|commed]] ''Gunner 4'' in an attempt to warn him. Gunner 4 received the link, albeit static-filled, just as the first defense tower was destroyed by incoming blaster fire. The transmission gave way to full static at the same moment that [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gobee]] of the Beast Riders appeared behind him. Gobee proceeded to shoot the gunner down while mocking his fallen comrade, Gunner 1.<ref name="TOTJA" /> The remaining defense towers were destroyed toward the end of the battle when the forces of Iziz were defeated.<ref name="BWOO" />

===Onderon Civil War===
[[File:IzizDefenseTower3951BBY.png|thumb|right|180px|An Iziz air defense tower circa [[3951 BBY]].]]
{{Quote|That's an air defense tower. The whole city's filled with them.|Captain Riiken, to the Jedi Exile|audio=AirDefenseTower.flac|<ref name="kotor2" />}}
{{GameLSmechanics|Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords}}
By the time the [[Meetra Surik|Jedi Exile]] visited Iziz nearly fifty years later, the defense towers had been replaced by a network of [[air defense tower]]s. During the [[Onderon Civil War]]'s [[Battle of Onderon (Onderon Civil War)|second battle]], these towers attempted to shoot down a modified [[Basilisk war droid/Legends|Basilisk war droid]] that had been loaned to the Exile by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] under [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]] [[Canderous Ordo]], which she used to return to the planet in order to relieve [[Onderon Royalist]] forces protecting [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Talia (Onderon)|Talia]]. The towers failed, as the assault vehicle was too fast and too heavily-[[Armor/Legends|armored]] for them to destroy. The Exile and her companions successfully landed amidst the ruined Merchant Quarter and set out to engage those troops loyal to [[General/Legends|General]] [[Vaklu]]'s [[Sith Triumvirate|Sith]]-backed attempted coup d'état. After its crew was killed by Royalist forces, one of these towers was hijacked by the Exile, which she then used to shoot down a number of Vaklu-aligned [[Aurek-class tactical strikefighter|Aurek fighters]] that were attacking Royalist positions within the [[Iziz Royal Palace]].<ref name="kotor2" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
These structures first appeared in the [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi (comic series)|''Tales of the Jedi'']] story arc [[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – Ulic Qel-Droma and the Beast Wars of Onderon|''Ulic Qel-Droma and the Beast Wars of Onderon'']], and were mentioned in the [[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|audio dramatization]]. In the computer and [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]'', they again make an appearance, however the structure of the towers is depicted differently. They are described by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Riiken]] as an "air defense tower" in the game's dialogue; in addition, the officer will give the player a small briefing on the Beast Wars if asked.
